messages:
liz: @here Quick announcement — we’re kicking off the Community Summer Hackathon + Maintainer Drive. Call for project proposals, mentors, and new maintainers. Dates: July 12–18 (virtual) with an optional in-person coworking day in SF. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-hackathon (see /starters and /docs). Sign-up form: https://tinyurl.com/rw-community-hack. Signups close June 30. More details below.

sam: Love this — any suggested themes or focus areas?

liz: Short list of themes: inference optimizations, low-cost embeddings pipelines, realtime monitoring & evals playground. But open to other proposals.

maria: Can we reuse the contrib starter kit? Also, what’s the expected time commitment for maintainers?

liz: Yes — starter kits from the contrib bundle are updated and linked in the repo. Maintainers: expect ~3–5 hrs/week for triage during the drive window (July 5–20). Mentors may spend more. We’ll publish a rota and on-call doc.

robin: I can mentor the monitoring/evals track — adding myself to the form.

ci-bot: CI: new PR check passed on community-hackathon/starter-template #112 :white_check_mark:

sam: Will there be prizes or Redwood credits for winners?

liz: Yep — microgrants + Redwood credits + community spotlight. We’ve budgeted ~$5k for microgrants and some swag.

maria: Any chance maintainers get a small stipend for reviews?

liz: We’ll prioritize stipends for actively supporting maintainers; DM me your team/org so we can allocate.

robin: Are there accessibility guidelines for workshops and demos?

liz: Great point — accessibility checklist lives in /docs/accessibility.md in the repo. We’ll run a pre-hack maintainer sync the week of June 28 to cover inclusivity, onboarding, and triage playbooks.

sam: What’s the target number of projects/participants?

liz: Targeting ~50 projects, capacity for ~200 contributors. If demand exceeds supply, we’ll run a waitlist and scale up maintainers.

maria: Will contributors need a CLA or other legal agreement for grants?

liz: For small contributions no CLA. For microgrants we’ll use a DCO and optional CLA for larger grants — legal is already in the loop.

sam: I can help promote this on our channels and social.

liz: Amazing — will add a promo doc with sample copy. Thanks all :tada: If you want to volunteer as a maintainer or mentor but can’t fill the form, DM me and I’ll add you.

robin: Minor ask — can we get a pinned thread in #community and a short announcement in the weekly digest?

liz: Yes — planning a pinned post and a blurb for the weekly digest.

maria: Nice — excited to see the repo.

liz: Repo link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-hackathon. Starter templates are under /starters. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
